description: This file acts as a runtime barrel aggregating and re-exporting types, functions, and constants related to the LINE extension of the openclaw project. It centralizes exports from multiple internal modules, maintaining explicit exports for the plugin SDK and internal source files, facilitating organized access to various functionalities.

methods.name: clearAccountEntryFields
methods.description: Resets or clears account entry fields in the SDK.

methods.name: buildChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Constructs the configuration schema for a channel.

methods.name: buildComputedAccountStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Generates a snapshot of account status.

methods.name: buildTokenChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of the token channel status.

methods.name: setSetupChannelEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a setup channel.

methods.name: isSenderAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender is allowed to perform an action.

methods.name: normalizeDmAllowFromWithStore
methods.description: Normalizes direct message allow-from settings with storage.

methods.name: probeLineBot
methods.description: Probes LINE bot configurations or status.

methods.name: buildTemplateMessageFromPayload
methods.description: Constructs a template message from payload.

methods.name: pushTextMessageWithQuickReplies
methods.description: Sends text message with quick reply options.

methods.name: hasLineDirectives
methods.description: Checks for LINE directives in payload.

methods.name: createAppleTvRemoteCard
methods.description: Creates an Apple TV remote control card.

methods.name: toFlexMessage
methods.description: Converts to a Flex Message format.

methods.name: createRichMenuAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a rich menu.

methods.name: getDefaultRichMenuId
methods.description: Retrieves the default rich menu ID.

methods.name: getRichMenuIdOfUser
methods.description: Retrieves the rich menu ID associated with a user.

methods.name: getRichMenuList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of rich menus.

methods.name: linkRichMenuToUser
methods.description: Links a rich menu to a user.

methods.name: linkRichMenuToUsers
methods.description: Links a rich menu to multiple users.

methods.name: setDefaultRichMenu
methods.description: Sets a rich menu as default.

methods.name: unlinkRichMenuFromUser
methods.description: Unlinks a rich menu from a user.

methods.name: unlinkRichMenuFromUsers
methods.description: Unlinks rich menus from multiple users.

methods.name: uploadRichMenuImage
methods.description: Uploads an image for a rich menu.
